description: Bus stops is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This data set shows the locations of the bus stops within the city of Melbourne, As the city of Melbourne do not run the bus services, this is simply to show the locations of the stops, this data does not include the services that run from each of the stops. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are accessibility, bus stops, eventsplanner, signs. The portal shows 309 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
